Katalog ini murni data-driven berdasarkan kreasi Anda sendiri.

Cara Membuat Bangunan Baru:
1. Klik tombol '+ Desain Baru di Studio (128x128)' di sebelah kiri, atau gunakan command /kandang <nama> dan /fasilitas <nama>.
2. Bangun kandang atau fasilitas kebun binatang sesuka Anda.
3. Simpan desain dan bangunan Anda siap ditempatkan di area tanah zoo!

zootycoon.species.mini_sheep.fun_fact: Mini sheep are gentle grazers selectively bred for small pastures, producing soft wool while keeping grasslands trimmed.
zootycoon.species.deer.fun_fact: Deer have keen senses of hearing and smell to detect predators, and their antlers can regrow every single year.
zootycoon.species.raccoon.fun_fact: Raccoons possess dexterous front paws that function like small hands, often washing their food in clean water before eating.
zootycoon.species.capybara.fun_fact: Capybaras are the largest living rodents in the world and love semi-aquatic habitats, often resting peacefully alongside other animals.
zootycoon.species.tortoise.fun_fact: Tortoises can live for well over a century, moving slowly to conserve energy while browsing on leaves and grasses.
zootycoon.species.capuchin_monkey.fun_fa: Capuchin monkeys are highly intelligent primates renowned for using stones and sticks as natural tools to crack open tough nuts.
zootycoon.species.kangaroo.fun_fact: Kangaroos use powerful hind legs and large muscular tails for balance while hopping at high speeds across arid plains.
zootycoon.species.ostrich.fun_fact: Ostriches are the largest living birds; unable to fly, they can sprint across open savannas at speeds up to 70 kilometers per hour.
zootycoon.species.zebra.fun_fact: Each zebra displays a unique pattern of black and white stripes that confounds biting flies and creates visual confusion for predators.
zootycoon.species.camel.fun_fact: Camels store nutrient-rich fat in their humps rather than water, allowing them to endure long desert journeys with minimal nourishment.
zootycoon.species.black_bear.fun_fact: American black bears are agile tree climbers with a keen sense of smell, foraging berries, honey, fish, and tender shoots across forest habitats.
zootycoon.species.panda.fun_fact: Giant pandas spend up to 12 hours every day munching on bamboo shoots, possessing an enlarged wrist bone that functions like an opposable thumb.
zootycoon.species.giant_anteater.fun_fac: Giant anteaters use their long tubular snouts and sticky tongues to flick up thousands of ants and termites each day without teeth.
zootycoon.species.rhinoceros.fun_fact: Rhinoceroses carry thick protective skin folds and prominent keratin horns, using mud wallows to stay cool and shield themselves from insects.
zootycoon.species.toucan.fun_fact: Toucans sport oversized yet remarkably lightweight honeycomb-structured bills that help regulate body heat while plucking tropical fruits.
zootycoon.species.gazelle.fun_fact: Gazelles are swift savanna antelopes famous for high bounding leaps called stotting, signaling alertness and agility to nearby predators.
zootycoon.species.giraffe.fun_fact: Giraffes are the tallest terrestrial animals, browsing treetops with long prehensile tongues that can reach up to 45 centimeters in length.
zootycoon.species.hippo.fun_fact: Hippos secrete a reddish natural oil known as blood sweat that moisturizes their skin and acts as a natural sunblock and antimicrobial.
zootycoon.species.gorilla.fun_fact: Gorillas are gentle vegetarian giants sharing over 98 percent of human DNA, living in close-knit family troops led by a dominant silverback.
zootycoon.species.elephant.fun_fact: Elephants possess remarkable memory and empathy, communicating across miles via low-frequency infrasonic rumbles felt through their feet.
zootycoon.species.alligator.fun_fact: Alligators are ancient reptilian ambush predators that navigate freshwater swamps with specialized sensory pits along their powerful jaws.
zootycoon.species.komodo_dragon.fun_fact: Komodo dragons are the largest living lizards on Earth, using serrated teeth and venomous saliva glands to subdue prey on tropical islands.
zootycoon.species.anaconda.fun_fact: Green anacondas are among the heaviest snakes in the world, submerging quietly in murky river shallows while waiting to ambush prey.
zootycoon.species.mantis_shrimp.fun_fact: Mantis shrimps deliver underwater clubbing strikes with the acceleration of a bullet, creating superheated cavitation bubbles.
zootycoon.species.lion.fun_fact: Lions are the only truly social felids, hunting collaboratively in coordinated prides across wide open savannas and dry grasslands.
zootycoon.species.tiger.fun_fact: Tigers are powerful solitary hunters that relish swimming in jungle rivers, each carrying a striped fur pattern as unique as human fingerprints.
zootycoon.species.grizzly_bear.fun_fact: Grizzly bears build massive fat reserves each autumn by catching migrating salmon and feasting on wild berries before winter hibernation.
zootycoon.species.snow_leopard.fun_fact: Snow leopards inhabit rugged alpine crags, using enormous fur-covered paws as natural snowshoes and long thick tails for balance and warmth.
zootycoon.species.polar_bear.fun_fact: Polar bears possess translucent hollow fur that traps sunlight over black heat-absorbing skin, allowing them to swim in subzero arctic seas.
zootycoon.species.mammoth.fun_fact: Woolly mammoths were ice age giants insulated by dense shaggy coats and curved tusks used for sweeping away deep snow to graze on tundra grasses.
zootycoon.species.froststalker.fun_fact: Froststalkers are agile cold-dwelling carnivores that leap gracefully across frozen tundra ledges, hunting in packs under harsh blizzards.
zootycoon.species.bunfungus.fun_fact: Bunfungus are gentle woodland creatures that thrive in mushroom colonies, spreading beneficial spores that revitalize nearby forest soil.
zootycoon.species.orca.fun_fact: Orcas are apex oceanic predators with sophisticated acoustic dialects, collaborating in matriarchal pods with incredible intelligence.
zootycoon.species.cachalot_whale.fun_fac: Cachalot whales dive into pitch-black abyssal trenches to hunt giant squids, utilizing powerful echolocation clicks that stun prey.
zootycoon.species.great_white_shark.fun_: Great white sharks sense minute electrical impulses from marine creatures using specialized ampullae of Lorenzini along their snouts.
zootycoon.species.giant_squid.fun_fact: Giant squids dwell in deep oceanic realms, possessing dinner-plate-sized eyes to detect faint bioluminescent flickers in perpetual darkness.
zootycoon.species.mungus.fun_fact: Mungus are curious fungal creatures whose mushroom-capped backs emit gentle spores that nourish delicate underground ecosystems.
zootycoon.species.guster.fun_fact: Gusters harness swirling desert winds to glide across sun-scorched sand dunes, whipping up miniature dust devils when startled.
zootycoon.species.rocky_roller.fun_fact: Rocky rollers curl into dense armored spheres when navigating steep badlands terrain, rolling safely past jagged canyon stones.
zootycoon.species.flutter.fun_fact: Flutters are ethereal flying beings that hover over blossoms, spreading floral radiance that encourages lush botanical growth.
